Ancient wisdom meets modern science

Rooted in Garbh Sanskar

The ancient Indian science of conscious prenatal connection — educating, nurturing, and communicating with the soul of your child from the very beginning. Your baby is already listening. Already learning. Already responding to you.

🎵

Sound & Music

From 18 weeks, your baby hears. By 24 weeks they actively respond — heart rate changing, turning toward sounds they love. Sanskrit mantras and classical ragas are mathematically structured to harmonise the developing nervous system.

🤲

Touch & Abhyanga

Warm oil massage with conscious intention — the most ancient conversation between mother and child. The nervous system calms. The body feels held. And in that holding, it opens. This is not skincare. This is communion.

🌬️

Breath & Pranayama

Bhramari — the humming bee breath — sends vibration directly to your baby when your hands rest on your belly. Modern neuroscience confirms: long exhales activate the vagus nerve, your direct line to calm. Ancient and modern say the same thing.

💬

Intention & Sankalpa

Every word you speak with intention lands in the nervous system of your growing child. This is not metaphor — this is epigenetics. Your emotional state creates the biochemical environment your baby develops inside. Speak to them. They are listening.

"When modern physiology and ancient wisdom say the same thing — oxytocin needs safety, Shakti flows when you feel safe — you know you have found something true."

More than birth prep

A way of living
your pregnancy

Birth Wisdom gives you a daily rhythm that carries you from morning to night — a complete framework for a conscious, nourishing pregnancy.

Wake

Hands on belly — greet your baby — before the phone, before anything. "Good morning, little one. We are here. We are safe." This is Garbh Sanskar from the first moment of waking.

Body

Abhyanga — sacred oil massage — warm sesame or coconut oil, slow strokes upward, circular over the belly. As your hands move over your womb, speak to your baby. Tell them how loved they are.

Breath

10 minutes of daily breathwork — regulate your nervous system, calm your baby, and rehearse the tools you will use in labour. Every breath practised is a deposit for the birth day.

Journal

Morning pages & baby letters — write whatever comes. Write your fears so they lose their power. Write to your baby. There is nothing more sacred than a pregnant woman's handwriting to herself.

Move

Labour positions & body prep — from 30 weeks, 20 minutes of daily squatting, cat-cow, pelvic floor release. Your pelvis is learning to open. Give it practice.

Unwind

Sacred playlist & Bhramari — let the sounds of your pregnancy playlist fill the room. Hum to your baby. The vibration of the humming bee breath travels directly to them through your belly.

Read

A spiritual text or story aloud — read to your baby. Poetry, sacred texts, even the news of your day. The content matters less than the consistency and the love in your voice. They are listening.

Partner

Partner massage & womb talk — your partner gently massages your lower back and hips, or places hands on your belly and speaks softly to the baby. This is how fathers bond before birth. The baby feels both of you.

Write

A letter to your baby — before sleep, write one thing: what happened today, what you felt, what you want them to know. These letters become the most sacred record of this time.

Rest

Womb meditation before sleep — the guided meditation from this bundle, or simply hands on belly, 10 slow breaths, visualising golden light filling your womb. You and your baby rest together.

Questions

What trimester is this for?

Any. First, second, or third — this meets you wherever you are. The earlier you begin the daily practices, the deeper they go. But even at 36 weeks, the breathwork, meditation, and masterclass are worth starting right now.

I'm having a caesarean. Is this still for me?

Completely. Birth is sacred in every form. The breathwork, affirmations, partner guide, and golden hour practices are entirely relevant. Your preparation matters just as much — it is your power, regardless of how your baby arrives.

What is Garbh Sanskar and is it only for certain cultures?

Garbh Sanskar is the ancient Indian science of conscious prenatal connection — nurturing the soul of your child through sound, intention, touch, and food from conception through birth. It is for every woman who believes that what she feels, hears, and speaks during pregnancy matters to her baby. Because it does.

How is this different from hypnobirthing?

This includes breathwork and anchoring techniques, but goes much deeper — weaving in Ayurvedic morning practices, Garbh Sanskar prenatal connection, Shakti wisdom, and the ancient–modern synthesis that is Oshikha's unique teaching. It is a complete pregnancy practice, not just a birth technique.

How is everything delivered?

Instantly, by email, immediately after purchase — the PDF guide, meditation audio, playlist link, and masterclass recording. Everything is yours to keep, download, and return to as many times as you need.
